description: The scheme used by this project since v0.2: model, version, image id, timestamp and prompt. Same fields, same order, same meaning as the WM01 body, but framed by the WM02 container and using 4 byte length prefixes. Use the legacy encode wrapper if you need byte exact WM01 output.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Name of the model that produced the image

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version of the model or of the schema

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Unix time at which the watermark was created
